why: Neither must_catch item is met. Item 1: the verifier's Check 4 says "Test the live page itself" and curls https://o.github.io/greet-cli/, then reports FAIL before merge. It is supposed to check, at the PR head, that docs/index.md lists --shout and that pages.yml publishes docs/ from main. That workflow check only shows up as an "Advisory (not part of any PASS/FAIL)" item. Item 2: Check 2 compares the output only to hand-written expected values: `test "$(node bin/greet.js Ada)" = "Hello, Ada!"`, an od -c byte pattern, and a usage line it describes from memory. It never runs the base commit's bin/greet.js to compare output from before and after the change. Running the existing tests with npm test isn't a comparison against the base either.
